comment: Catalyzes the intramolecular coupling reaction of griseophenone B in the griseofulvin pathway yielding desmethyl-dehydrogriseofulvin A.

reactions.description: GsfF catalyzes the intramolecular coupling reaction of griseophenone B, through either a di-radical ring coupling mechanism or an arene oxide intermediate. CYP oxireductase is required.
Oxidative coupling of orcinol and phloroglucinol yielding desmethyl-dehydrogriseofulvin A
